wagerTime.title: Wager Time
wagerTime.help: The amount of time every player has to make their wager for the round. This is only used if wagers are enabled.

dealerSecondCard.title: Dealer Second Card
dealerSecondCard.help: Determines whether the dealer's second card is shown face-up (visible) or face-down (hidden). When the second card is visible, players gain a significant edge over the dealer.

wager.title: Wager
wager.help: When enabled, players can wager points at the start of their turn. If they win the round, their wager is doubled; if they lose, they keep their original points. Players cannot wager more points than they have.

startPointAmount.title: Starting Points
startPointAmount.help: The number of points each player begins with.

basePointAmount.title: Base Points
basePointAmount.help: The points a player is guaranteed to earn when they win a round against the dealer.

blackjackBonusPointAmount.title: Bonus Blackjack Points
blackjackBonusPointAmount.help: Additional points (on top of the "Base Points") awarded when a player wins a round with a blackjack.

doubleDown.title: Double Down
doubleDown.help: When enabled, players can double their wager on their first move for a hand, receive exactly one additional card, and then stand automatically.

split.title: Split
split.help: When enabled, players can split their initial two cards into two separate hands if both cards have the same value.

insurance.title: Insurance
insurance.help: When enabled and the dealer shows an Ace, players can place an insurance side wager to reduce losses if the dealer has blackjack.

naturalBlackjack.title: Natural Blackjack
naturalBlackjack.help: When enabled, a two-card 21 (Ace + 10-value card) wins the hand immediately.

aceHandling.title: Ace Handling
aceHandling.help: Choose how an Ace is scored. The dynamic option automatically counts the Ace as 1 if counting it as 11 would cause the hand to exceed 21.

splitSameFaceOnly.title: Split Requires Same Face
splitSameFaceOnly.help: When enabled, splitting is only allowed if both starting cards are the same face (for example K+K or 8+8), not just the same numeric value.

fiveCardCharlie.title: Five Card Charlie
fiveCardCharlie.help: When enabled, any player hand with five cards totaling 21 or less wins automatically. This rule does not apply to the dealer.

gameplay.title: Gameplay
description: You start with two initial cards. You can choose to 'hit' (draw another card) or 'stand' (keep your current total).
The aim is to get as close to 21 as possible without exceeding it. An Ace is special, as it can count as either 1 or 11 points.

dealer.title: Dealer Rules
description: The dealer must hit on a total of 16 or less and stand on 17 or more.
The dealer's adherence to these rules adds an essential strategic component for the player.

objective.title: Objective
description: The goal is to have a hand value closer to 21 than the dealer's without busting (going over 21 points). If you end up with the same total as the dealer, it's called a 'push,' meaning you neither win nor lose points.
Achieving an initial total of 21 with two cards is called a 'blackjack,' which usually results in a special win condition.

wagering.title: Wagering
description: In our version of blackjack, you cannot wager with chips or real money. Instead, you can wager your points in the game, allowing you to outscore your opponents.
If you wager 10 points and win against the dealer without going bust, you will receive an additional 10 points. However, if you lose, you will lose the 10 points you wagered.

doubleDown.title: Double Down
description: Double down lets you double your current wager in exchange for committing to exactly one more card.
After receiving that card, your hand stands automatically, making this a high-risk, high-reward move.

split.title: Split
description: If your first two cards have the same value, you can split them into two separate hands.
A matching wager is placed on the new hand, and both hands are played independently against the dealer.

insurance.title: Insurance
description: When the dealer shows an Ace, you can place an optional side wager called insurance.
Insurance pays out if the dealer has blackjack, but is lost if the dealer does not.

winCondition.title: Win Condition
description: By default, the game ends after 10 rounds, and a winner is selected based on who has the most points.
You can customize the rules and win condition for your custom game in the lobby settings. Alternatively, you can end the game when a player reaches X amount of points.
